rationale: The trade is working exactly per thesis — price just broke to a new session low ($40.51 vs LOD $40.54) on 9.87x relative volume, remains firmly rejected below VWAP ($42.84), and the tape stays risk-off, leaving roughly 4% of air toward the $38.89 gap fill with no reversal signature (the 44k-share push to $41.04 failed and the breakdown candle closed on its low). A flip to long would be a countertrend catch against fresh lows with no absorption or capitulation evidence, and closing would forfeit a validated winner only 7 minutes in. Keeping the original invalidation and 2% trailing exit preserves the continuation setup while the trailing mechanism tightens risk as price falls.
